coaching.headline: Lt. Belica's ten kills, a tankless draft into ten enemy hard-CC abilities and an unconverted Orb Prime decided this loss.

flags.text: Lt. Belica ran the damn game at 10/2/4, killing Renna, Mourn and Kallari three times each.
Orb Prime bought shit all: TwinBlast's duo outer was the only allied structure, against eight enemy structure takes.
Zero tanks and two divers, Greystone and Kallari, against Kaelen's frontline and ten enemy hard-CC abilities to four.
Enemy scored the last five kills; the allied duo inner, mid inhibitor and Core fell during and after.

focus.title: Draft a tank, respect Belica, cash Orb Prime
focus.action: Draft a tank, and when Lt. Belica is unseen, Renna, Mourn and Kallari hold until Seismic Assault is used before committing; after Orb Prime, push the nearest standing tower before anything else.

8.2.call: Three separate plays: Lt. Belica killed Renna on mid, Kaelen killed Greystone on the offlane and Dekker killed Mourn on the duo lane, then enemy Mini Prime and Fangtooth. After three early deaths, concede the pits and reset together.

16.6.call: Separate plays again: Grux killed Greystone on the offlane while Renna traded a kill on Kaelen for a death to Lt. Belica on mid, then Lt. Belica killed Kallari in the allied jungle and the allied mid outer fell. After a one-for-one on mid, reset before the next engage on Lt. Belica.

26.5.call: Won 3-0 on mid with Mourn already down: Greystone killed Grux, Kallari killed Kaelen and Dekker, and Orb Prime went allied. In the next fight Kallari killed Lt. Belica, Kaelen took Shaper seconds later, and the rest of that fight, won 3-2, came after Shaper fell. When the first kill lands in a Shaper window, the team turns onto Shaper at once.

31.8.call: Kaelen took Primal Fangtooth, then Kira, Grux and Lt. Belica killed Kallari, Renna and Mourn across the allied jungle, mid and duo lane, and the mid inhibitor dropped. After a lost Primal, all five defend the inhibitor together.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: One death, the fewest of all ten players, and the only allied structure: the enemy duo outer. After an enemy outer falls, call the jungler and siege the next tower.
Hero damage 752 per minute against an own average of 998, on the allied high of 17730 gold. When Greystone or Kallari opens a fight, fire from behind Mourn immediately.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Five deaths, over double an own average: two to Grux, one to Kaelen on the offlane. With Kaelen unseen, keep every Grux trade short.
Took the allied Mini Prime, mitigated 38281 damage for the allied high and killed Grux twice and Kaelen once. In grouped fights, take the first hits for Renna and TwinBlast.
28b58cb2-c0f3-4eb6-af50-b87a4d614bb4: Seven kills, an allied high, three enemy wards cleared, but one ward placed against an own average of 4.4. If wards were equipped but idle, swap to sentry and sweep.
Three of four deaths went to Lt. Belica, one on mid outside any detected fight. Sidestep the Seismic Assault line, and dive Lt. Belica only once Seismic Assault is used.
800dd997-0b43-483b-b5ad-fde82d6c8920: Eight deaths, the game's most: three to Lt. Belica, four on mid away from the duo lane. Before stepping into mid, wait for Kallari or Renna to show.
Ran the vision with 18 wards against an own average of 9.4 and ten assists, yet Dekker placed 24. Before each Fangtooth, fill Leafsong's three-ward cap around the pit.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Three of five deaths to Lt. Belica, all on mid in the allied half, and a single kill. If Lt. Belica keeps getting kills, buy World Breaker for tenacity next.
Hero damage 412 per minute against an own average of 726, lowest of the five allies. After Overseer, open grouped fights with the ultimate, which Overseer boosts and heals from.

matchup: First blood landed on Dekker in the duo lane; the field gives this carry into Kira 50.9%.
The only death came to Grux on mid, the first kill of the enemy closing run.
build: Solaris and Vanquisher are two of the 56.4% core; Ashbringer never made the build.
Into Kira, the most played core is Solaris, Ashbringer and Imperator at 60.8%.
Sky Splitter's Rend adds a share of the target's current health on basic attacks, reduced for ranged heroes.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles when damaging a low-health hero; no execute.
Weald trails Lotus and Xyris, the toss-up leaders in this carry field.
Forage with Wind-Rider is the best Weald pair in the field.
augment: Grenadier adds a Vortex Grenades charge, and Rocket Dash grants one charge on use.
Grenadier is the clear field lead over Amplified Burst for this carry. Sound keep.
crest: Pacifier's Adrenalize dashes and empowers the next physical damage instance.
Liberator leads a toss-up in this carry field; Pacifier, the most run, trails.
improvement: Ashbringer over Scattershot completes the 56.4% core with Solaris and Vanquisher.
Liberator over Pacifier trades the dash for a cleanse and shield into ten enemy hard-CC abilities.

matchup: Grux was the lane opponent; the field gives this offlane into Grux 52.5%.
Grux and this offlane traded two kills each, and Grux razed the allied offlane inner.
build: Overlord and Rapture are two of the 57.9% core; Aegis Of Agawar never made the build.
The field buys Tainted Blade more often into Grux, and Grux healed 16033 here.
Forticus, finished last, adds tenacity against ten enemy hard-CC abilities.
eternal: Krix grows maximum health with level and sits in the toss-up lead group for this offlane.
Voracity with Cannibalism is the best Krix pair; Regenerative Tissue with Cannibalism was run.
augment: Tainted Oath makes Sacred Oath apply Blight to enemies.
Tainted Oath ties Imperial Soul in a toss-up for this offlane field. Sound keep.
crest: Saphir's Mantle adds health plus physical and magical armor; Atlas grows size and max health.
Eviscerator and Saphir's Mantle tie in a toss-up for this offlane. Sound keep.
improvement: Aegis Of Agawar completes the 57.9% core and adds magical armor against Lt. Belica's burst.
Voracity over Regenerative Tissue trades regen out of combat for healing on every unit kill.

matchup: Kaelen was the jungle opponent; the field gives this jungle into Kaelen 41.6%.
Kaelen took every Fangtooth, the Primal Fangtooth and Shaper; this jungle took Orb Prime.
build: Malady and Vanquisher match the 57.1% core into Kaelen; Spear Of Desolation never made the build.
Vanquisher and Imperator are two of the 64.9% core; Manta Scythe was not built.
No magical armor item, while Lt. Belica's Caustica ignored 35% of magical armor.
eternal: Lotus grants a random stat every two minutes and on every takedown.
Lotus leads a toss-up in this jungle field. Sound keep.
Early Bloom with Prima Donna is the best Lotus pair; Masterpiece with Immaculate was run.
augment: Deadly Finesse cuts Crippling Dagger's cooldown on hero hits or unit kills and restores mana on hero hits.
Deadly Finesse leads a toss-up with Execution Mandate in this jungle field. Sound keep.
crest: Nex's Reap dashes and hits nearby heroes, boosted by stored Sow damage.
Ortus leans ahead in this jungle field; Nex trails.
improvement: Salvation, the tenacity answer in the notes, adds health against ten enemy hard-CC abilities.
If Lt. Belica keeps landing kills, a magical armor item answers that burst.
Ortus over Nex trades Reap's dash damage for speed and permanent physical power from takedowns.

matchup: Dekker and Kira were the duo opponents; the field gives this support into Dekker 52.8%.
Kaelen and Dekker each killed this support twice; Dekker out-warded this support 24 to 18.
build: Astral Catalyst and Tainted Scepter are two of the 62.6% core; Megacosm was not built.
Tainted Scepter was finished last, just before the final lost fight.
Dynamo adds physical armor, and an immobilized enemy takes more damage briefly.
eternal: Knell shreds enemy physical and magical armor with Rust stacks and grants part of the shred.
Knell is the clear field lead for this support. Sound keep.
Patina with Resonant Repair is the best Knell pair; Patina with Peal was run.
augment: Nightstalker raises Eclipse's bonus movement speed.
Nightmare Extractor leans ahead of Nightstalker in this support field.
crest: Leafsong's Phantom Rush speeds nearby allies and grants slow immunity; Visionary raises the ward cap.
Rift Walkers and Tranquility lead a toss-up for this support; Leafsong trails.
improvement: Lt. Belica scored three of eight deaths, no magical armor built; versus a fed mage, buy magical armor sooner.
Resonant Repair over Peal restores health and grants tenacity whenever immobilized, against ten enemy hard-CC abilities.
Nightmare Extractor over Nightstalker trades Eclipse speed for a shorter Extract cooldown on each cast.

matchup: Lt. Belica was the lane opponent; the field gives this mid into Lt. Belica 51.3%.
Seismic Assault stuns in a line after a short delay, and Neural Disruptor silences.
Lt. Belica's 30 ability haste came from Prophecy and Orion.
build: Entropy, Wraith Leggings and Overseer, the 55.9% most played core into Lt. Belica, were all built.
Combustion came third, outside the 69.2% core of Entropy, Overseer and Oblivion Crown.
eternal: Vesh adds a damage-over-time share to ability damage on heroes.
Lotus leans ahead of Vesh, the most run, in this mid field.
Lich with Mind Rot is the best Vesh pair; Lich with Millennia was run.
augment: Netherward grants a shield on each Soulfire cast.
Netherward is the clear field lead for this mid. Sound keep.
crest: Epoch's Stasis Device puts the holder in Stasis.
Soulbearer is the clear field lead for this mid; Epoch trails.
improvement: World Breaker, the tenacity answer in the notes, adds health against Lt. Belica's stun and silence.
Oblivion Crown over Combustion completes the 69.2% core with Entropy and Overseer.
Soulbearer over Epoch trades the Stasis active for a shield.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Mourn Abduct (pull). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Mourn) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Vortex Grenade slow → Vaporize pierce → Rocket Dash reposition → Ventilate barrage
ourKits.winCondition: weave abilities for Gunslinger triple-shots and keep Rocket Dash up by hitting heroes
ourKits.passive: casting an ability grants attack speed and makes the next basic fire three times
ourKits.playWith: a frontline that creates space for him to keep shooting
ourKits.playAgainst: Rocket Dash is his only escape and comes back faster when he hits heroes, so engage right after he uses it; Ventilate is a short channel worth interrupting

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap in, Make Way to shred armor, Sacred Oath empowered cleave to slow, then Stone Forged Soul to heal in Stasis and crash down.
ourKits.winCondition: Stay in the middle of fights and use Stone Forged Soul's missing-health heal to reset, while Make Way shreds armor for the team.
ourKits.passive: Stoicism deflects the next basic attack on a cooldown and grants health regen and armor that grow as he loses health.
ourKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow his leap and benefit from Make Way's armor shred.
ourKits.playAgainst: Do not burst into Stone Forged Soul's Stasis; step away from the slow and the crash, then re-engage. Open with an ability since Stoicism deflects a basic, and buy anti-heal to cut the ult heal.

ourKits.combo: Shadow Walk into Camouflage, Crippling Dagger to slow, Shadow Dance onto the Death Marked target for double damage, then Guillotine to execute.
ourKits.winCondition: Catch an isolated low-health target from Camouflage and finish them with Guillotine's missing-health damage.
ourKits.passive: Death Mark reveals targets she damages and detonates for missing-health true damage, and she can jump extra times in the air.
ourKits.playWith: A team that follows up on her picks and fights around vision.
ourKits.playAgainst: Ward and stay near teammates since nearby heroes and wards reveal Camouflage. Guillotine has a brief delay before the dash, so CC her during it or after Shadow Dance; stay healthy since her damage grows on low targets.

ourKits.combo: Abduct to pull a target in, Beguile to Mesmerize the group, Contagion to heal allies and shred enemy armor, and Eclipse to blind the enemy team's vision and spread Contagion map-wide.
ourKits.winCondition: Pull a target into his team with Abduct, lock the fight with Beguile and keep allies healthy with Contagion.
ourKits.passive: Extract: his next basic attack cleaves for bonus damage and restores health.
ourKits.playWith: Burst damage that punishes his pulled or Mesmerized target and benefits from the armor shred.
ourKits.playAgainst: Abduct and Beguile are both visible channels that slow Mourn, so sidestep the vines and walk out of the growing Beguile radius before it erupts. Anti-heal blunts Contagion and Extract.

ourKits.combo: Mortal Coil to pull enemies together and heal from them, Stupor from the air to Mesmerize, Soulfire waves for damage, then Abyssal Rift to teleport in and fire the singularity.
ourKits.winCondition: Collect Essence to grow every ability, then zone fights with Mortal Coil and Abyssal Rift and execute low targets.
ourKits.passive: Echoes of the Damned: nearby deaths can drop Essence (heroes always do) that she collects to empower her abilities, and she can hover after a mid-air jump.
ourKits.playWith: A frontline that keeps enemies inside Mortal Coil and the singularity.
ourKits.playAgainst: Watch for the 1.5s Abyssal Rift channel and leave the target area, and dodge the Stupor orb after she rises. Anti-heal cuts Mortal Coil healing; trade early before she stacks Essence.

enemyKits.combo: Stampede to drag a target, Smash 'n Grab to pull and stun, Warlord's Challenge to stun and steal power, then Double Pain to cleave and heal.
enemyKits.winCondition: Chain pull and stuns onto one target while Bloodlust bleed stacks and Warlord's Challenge attack speed shred them.
enemyKits.passive: Bloodlust makes basics stack a bleed for damage over time.
enemyKits.playWith: Follow-up damage that can hit the target he drags and stuns.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Stampede has a delay before the charge and Smash 'n Grab channels before the shockwave, so sidestep both. Fight after he spends them, and buy anti-heal against Double Pain's heal.

enemyKits.combo: Void Drone for vision and mana drain, Seismic Assault to knock up and stun, Void Bomb, then Neural Disruptor to silence and finish.
enemyKits.winCondition: Drain mana with Void Drone and land Seismic Assault, then burst with Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage.
enemyKits.passive: Innovation upgrades each ability at max rank and grants ability haste.
enemyKits.playWith: Follow-up damage during Seismic Assault's knockup and stun.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Seismic Assault erupts after a short delay, so sidestep the line. Avoid casting near Void Drone since it zaps and drains mana, and dive her after Seismic Assault is used; magical armor helps.

enemyKits.combo: Rimefang to stun, slow and lay Rimeglass, Winter's Pursuit onto the Frostbitten target to root them, Razorstorm on Rimeglass, then Frostfall to crash down and root the center.
enemyKits.winCondition: Fight on his Rimeglass, where Razorstorm boosts his armor and Frostbite deals max health true damage and sets up Winter's Pursuit roots.
enemyKits.passive: Heart of Ice makes his abilities leave Rimeglass that slows and burns enemies with Frostbite.
enemyKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow up on his roots and Frostfall.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Step off Rimeglass so Frostbite ends before Winter's Pursuit can root you. Frostfall channels before he leaps, so move out of the center of the landing and leave the Rimestorm; tenacity helps against the roots.

enemyKits.combo: Containment Fence traps a target, Stasis Bomb stuns from range, Ion Strike blasts to stun the center and slow the edge, and Photon Disruptor slows
enemyKits.winCondition: trap a target in the fence and chain stuns so the team collapses
enemyKits.passive: jumping mid-air fires Rocket Boots upward and speeds nearby allies; abilities cut its cooldown
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her stun and fence into a kill
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb, whose stun gets longer the farther it travels; step out of the Ion Strike center during its delay; stay out of the fence ring or flank around it; tenacity shortens her stuns

enemyKits.combo: Mercy for 3 Vengeance stacks, Dusk to purify for burst and slow, Shadow Glide to reposition, then Purge while gliding as needed.
enemyKits.winCondition: Stack Vengeance with basics and abilities, then shred the team with Purge and reset Dusk and Shadow Glide on kills.
enemyKits.passive: Nevermore periodically makes her next basic or Mercy fire a Raven that deals current-health damage in a small area.
enemyKits.playWith: Peel that keeps divers off her while she channels Purge.
enemyKits.playAgainst: During Purge she cannot attack or cast anything but Shadow Glide and is slowed, so CC her then. Avoid feeding takedowns since they reset Shadow Glide, and expect Purge's anti-heal.

Out-tanked 0 v 1: teams one tank down won 48% in 1.18.
2 divers (Greystone, Kallari): each one past the first is a hero not holding the line.
One main mage and one main marksman at most.
Mourn can stay with the carry and peel.

lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Died 2 times in 33 minutes, fewer deaths than about 82% of Lt. Belica mid players this patch. The build added health and armor.
Neural Disruptor at top rank: 85s base, about 65.4s by the end (23% shorter) from 30 ability haste: Prophecy 15, Orion 15.
Lt. Belica dealt 33,925 hero damage, 26% of their team's, with +435 magical power from items.

Penetration: Caustica ignores 35%; against Kallari (level 17 estimated: about 60 magical armor, 39 after penetration) and Mourn (level 17 estimated: about 60 magical armor, 39 after penetration) that is about 15% and 15% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Prophecy (item): On Basic Attacks: Deal 20 (+15%) Damage On-Hit.
Orion (item): Upon successful On-Hit Attack: Deal 2% increased damage to the Target for 3.5s, up to a maximum of 16%.
Caustica (item): On dealing Ability Damage to a Hero: While they are above 50% Health. For every point of Bonus Magical Armor they possess. Deal 0.2% more Damage.

Claw Of Hermes (item): On Successful Basic Attack: Against Melee Heroes: Drain 2.5% of their Max Mana. Against Ranged Heroes: Drain 4% of their Max Mana. Deals True Damage equal to 75% of the Mana Drained.
Claw Of Hermes (item): Based on the Target's Missing Mana: Abilities deal 0-12% more Damage.
Toughness: +200 health; took 18,465 damage, mitigated 10,908, died 2 times.

Lesson: Lt. Belica's penetration cut through: Kallari took about 15% more magical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 17 (estimated) their armor was about 60, about 39 after 35% penetration).
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Prophecy, Orion, Claw Of Hermes.

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Caustica, Claw Of Hermes. Lt. Belica has 4 damaging abilities (Void Bomb, Seismic Assault, Void Drone hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 30 ability haste brought them back 23% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Countered? 0 of the 4 players Lt. Belica killed built magical armor. We killed Lt. Belica 2 times.
Copy it? Too few Lt. Belica midlane games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

lines: Lead story: Healed through fights. 486 healing a minute, more than 88% of Grux offlane players this patch.
Warlord's Challenge at top rank: 90s base, about 62.1s by the end (31% shorter) from 45 ability haste: Basilisk 20, Ashbringer 10, Draconum 15.
12 takedowns (4 kills, 8 assists) fed: Draconum (Flow).

Ashbringer (Chrono Strikes): On Successful Basic Attack: Decrease current Non-Ultimate Cooldowns by 8% On-Hit.• Reduced to 4% against Non-Heroes.• Only triggers once per ability.• Critical Strikes grant 1.5x the cooldown reduction.
Grux dealt 33,936 hero damage, 26% of their team's, with +165 physical power from items.
Forticus (item): Upon taking Hero damage: Gain a (+8%) Shield for 3.5s.
Forticus (item): Upon damaging or being damaged by Heroes: For the next 3s, gain Stats each second: (+0.6% Base Health) additional Max Health, +4 Movement Speed and +0.5% Size.
Sky Splitter (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Deal 5% of Target's Current Health as Damage On-Hit. Reduced to 3.5% for Ranged Heroes. Minimum of 12 Damage.
Draconum (item): On dealing damage to Heroes or Monsters: Gain 2% increased Healing for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.

Stacks up to 10 times.; Draconum: On Takedown: Restore (+120%)(+6%) Health.; 16,033 healing recorded.
Toughness: +625 health, +95 physical armor, +25% tenacity; took 42,602 damage, mitigated 47,240, died 3 times.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Ashbringer, Sky Splitter.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Sky Splitter, Draconum.
Stack (Kept alive in fights): 2 effects on one trigger: Basilisk, Forticus. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.
Countered? 1 of the 3 players Grux killed built physical armor (Greystone). Anti-heal on Greystone, Mourn. We killed Grux 3 times.
Copy it? Too few Grux offlane games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

duoLane.firstBlood: us (twinblast on dekker, in the duo lane)

evidence: 8 deaths, the most in the game (their norm on Mourn: 4.925925925925926).
3 of them to Lt. Belica.
Gold 11.6k vs Dekker 14.2k.
From 29.4m to 32.6m every kill was theirs (kills stood 15-18 before the run).

gameFlags.summary: draft broke the fundamentals: 0 tanks, 2 divers vs 1 tank, 1 diver
evidence: Us 0 tanks, 2 divers (48.1% in 1.18 ranked) vs them 1 tank, 1 diver (50.7%).
No real tank: nobody to start fights or take the first hits for the backline.
Out-tanked 0 v 1: teams one tank down won 48% in 1.18.
2 divers (Greystone, Kallari): each one past the first is a hero not holding the line.
Draft fix: Greystone (offlane) for a real tank: Kaelen 54.9%, Riktor 51.1%, Steel 50.7%.
Lt. Belica 10/2/4, 43% of their kills, 33925 hero damage.
Killed Renna 3, Mourn 3, Kallari 3, Greystone 1.
Hard CC: Seismic Assault (stun + knock-up), Neural Disruptor (silence).

Play against: Seismic Assault erupts after a short delay, so sidestep the line. Avoid casting near Void Drone since it zaps and drains mana, and dive her after Seismic Assault is used; magical armor helps.
Answers: Magical armor on whoever it kept killing. Tenacity on the players it caught.

Play against Lt. Belica: Seismic Assault erupts after a short delay, so sidestep the line. Avoid casting near Void Drone since it zaps and drains mana, and dive her after Seismic Assault is used; magical armor helps.
Item answer: Tenacity: Salvation.

gameFlags.summary: Renna kept dying to Lt. Belica (3 of 5)
evidence: Renna died 3 of 5 times to Lt. Belica.
Lt. Belica's hard CC: Seismic Assault (stun + knock-up), Neural Disruptor (silence).

Play against Lt. Belica: Seismic Assault erupts after a short delay, so sidestep the line. Avoid casting near Void Drone since it zaps and drains mana, and dive her after Seismic Assault is used; magical armor helps.
Item answer: Tenacity: World Breaker.

They brought 10 hard-CC abilities to our 4. Fight after Dekker's Stasis Bomb and Kaelen's Frostfall and Dekker's Ion Strike are used, spread out instead of grouping in a line, and the front line can buy tenacity.

Theirs: Grux Smash 'n Grab, Grux Stampede, Grux Warlord's Challenge, Lt. Belica Seismic Assault, Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor, Kaelen Rimefang, Kaelen Winter's Pursuit, Kaelen Frostfall, Dekker Stasis Bomb, Dekker Ion Strike.

bullets: Void Drone and basic attacks with Claw Of Hermes drained enemy mana, so Neural Disruptor and Claw Of Hermes' ability bonus hit harder on drained targets.
Vesh added damage over time to each ability hit on heroes, Mind Rot added current-health damage, and The Tenth Seal brought Neural Disruptor back sooner and stronger.
Void Bomb, Seismic Assault and Void Drone hit areas, reaching several heroes; Caustica added damage on heroes above 50% Health, and 30 ability haste returned casts 23% sooner.
Double Pain applies on-hit effects twice, so Sky Splitter hit twice per cast, and Draconum's stacks, built by each hit, boosted Double Pain's heal per enemy hero struck.
Thraex marked Grux's basic attack target for more damage and less damage from that hero; Savage Strikes healed per hit, doubled by Double Pain; Ferocity stacked attack speed.
Ashbringer cut non-ultimate cooldowns on basic attacks, bringing Smash 'n Grab and Stampede back sooner, while 45 ability haste cut Warlord's Challenge to about 62.1s.

coachLean.headline: Lt. Belica dealt 28213 magical damage, none of the four allies killed built magical armor, and the enemy took 8 structures to 1.

flags.text: Enemy took two Fangtooths and Shaper with no ally dead in the prior 60 seconds.
Lt. Belica went 10/2/4 with 33925 hero damage, killing Renna, Mourn and Kallari three times each.
Kills stood 15-18, then the enemy scored the last 5 and took mid inhibitor and core.
Zero tanks and two divers, Greystone and Kallari, against one enemy tank: nobody to take first hits.

focus.action: Contest every Fangtooth and Shaper as a group, start fights only after Lt. Belica spends Seismic Assault, sidestep the delayed line, and put magical armor on the three heroes Belica kept killing.
